Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-evidence.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: S2a-3 a2d795b is qualified: controlled Lexical/ContentTable/Unavailable wiring and v5 codec, exact hosted/consumer receipts. This does not establish ONNX execution, strict reference eligibility or all G1 acceptance. Embedding remains required for 1.0/Sherlock, even if lexical development precedes it.

Remaining / next action: Native reliability and S2a-4 are complete. S2b-1 bd-01M4BQWQN7DDCZT095ND23772A supplies concrete ONNX attempts/exact replay at d7c0d97. S2b-2 bd-01M4C13FZZQ1T0Z64WES25MMXB now supplies checked coordinate-free surface rendering and explicit checked raw/half cosine units at locally landed source b06b72a1b8744bfd3ee07b827a85f8219fd91b0a. Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/s2b2-surface-render-20261007; independent exact-SHA GO, 13 compiled named mutation kills, cold source 2336 Passed and consumer 485 Passed, no failures/errors/skips. This is LocallyObserved qualification, not hosted publication or strict embedding registration.
Next bounded slice: join library-owned RenderedContentPair payloads and declared EmbeddingMetric to concrete ONNX record/replay, actual model/configuration/render/candidate identities, and a single immutable controlled channel used by nomination/pricing. Half cosine maps [0,2] to [0,1] explicitly; it preserves ranking but changes weighted costs. Raw cosine must not silently enter strict pricing's [0,1] clamp. Historical video embedText/group-label rendering and frozen-preset parity require a named policy and qualification. Then adopt the originating shared evidence in StageTrace; reference and reconstruction must consume identical candidates, scores and evidence digest. No lexical substitution or coarse dependency bypass.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Current prerequisites (replace historical dependency prose): bd-01M2WVENSB0P955Y0B603CC20Y, bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9

Scheduling lane: next. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: evidence; lane: next.

Scope: align cost/candidates, embed-bench StageTrace/RecallToVideo

Acceptance criteria:
1. Extract candidate nomination, raw local score/cost evaluation and outcome receipts BEFORE HSMM/refinement. Both reference and GraphHsmm consume the same immutable evidence object; historical StageTrace adapter reads it.
2. Register deterministic lexical and existing embedding channels with finite score direction/scale, declared grain/empty-input policy, input/render/config/model/candidate identities and replay. Unavailable scores remain typed unavailable, not 0 or uniform.
3. Represent content-only scorer input separately from source coordinates/adjacency, so strict reference providers cannot read behavioral features. Audit retrieval and equal-score tie handling, not only decoder.
4. Compare evidence/state membership/term values and digest across both uses; same-platform legacy embedding evidence parity holds under the frozen preset. Refined emissions cannot be relabeled as base costs.
5. External support is NotApplicable or its distinct measured contract, not 1.0 from no terms. No scene-score allocation is presented as within-scene measurement. Guard and alias/forgery mutations fail.

Validation: proposed LocalMappingEvidenceSuite plus existing StageTraceSuite; no-network provider replay

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Removes D1B/benchmark-checkpoint prerequisite: this extraction uses existing checked target support; full film signature migration remains D1B.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
Evidence profiles use the same fixed unit inventory, source cut and candidate-accounting contract for annotation-only and annotation-plus-audiovisual inputs. Record feature availability/coverage, source occurrence and clock bindings, content/config/model/frame identities and acquisition receipts. Optional verified AV sidecars are consumed through existing feature/media contracts; unavailable evidence remains typed unavailable and is never silently replaced by another profile. Verify profile isolation and identity with offline synthetic/replayed sidecars. Caption production, remote-provider availability, fine localization and an AV accuracy gain are not completion prerequisites for shared evidence extraction. Existing media acquisition owns acquisition; H3 owns the controlled scientific comparison. Refinement may not relabel its emissions as shared base evidence.
